turns.instruction: Model the inclined cantilever from (x,z)=(0,0) to (6,3) m, fixed at the origin. The main point force is 20 kN at horizontal projection x=3 m; its direction has not been specified. A separate +X force of 8 kN acts at the free end. Request Ux and Uz at the main force location and fixed-end reaction My. Identify essential missing information before analysis.

The 20 kN main point force acts in global negative Z at (x,z)=(3,1.5) m. Analyze and report Ux and Uz there and reaction My at (0,0), with signed direction, units, D load case and turn 2. Retain the separate +X 8 kN free-end force.

Replace only the main point-force magnitude by 25 kN, retaining its global negative-Z direction and location (3,1.5) m. Reanalyze and report the same Ux, Uz and fixed-end reaction My for D and turn 3. Keep the +X 8 kN free-end force and all properties unchanged.
